description: Measuring Broadband Australia Report 26 Dataset Release (series on South Australian Government Data Directory) is a series of datasets listed in South Australian Government data directory (data.sa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Australian Competition and Consumer Commission. The Measuring Broadband Australia (MBA) program relies on households across Australia volunteering to receive a Whitebox that tests the performance of their fixed-line broadband services. Coverage: South Australia. The portal lists 22 near-identical datasets in this series (one per municipality, prefecture, year, month or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher Australian Competition and Consumer Commission. Its tags are Australian Competition and Consumer Commission, Fixed-line broadband services, Latency, Measuring Broadband Australia, download speeds. It offers 3 resource(s) in csv, pdf. The portal shows 2024-09-17 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution 2.5 Australia. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-sa.
